title: Charges and crunches
note: A charge takes two slots: the first charges (guarding like Scales), the second releases with +3. A hit during the charging slot breaks it. A crunch puts two attacks in one slot, 15 ticks each, with no modifiers; it needs Raking Talons (Claw) or Gnashing Teeth (Bite). Brine charges a Bite and lands it; Coil, a crunchling with Raking Talons, crunches its claws.
